title: Debt validation notice and dispute
facts: A covered debt collector generally must provide validation information about the debt in the initial communication or within five days, unless an exception applies.
The validation notice includes information about the debt and consumer rights, including a validation period for disputing the debt.

If a consumer timely disputes the debt in writing or requests original-creditor information as provided by law, collection activity on the disputed amount generally must pause until required verification or information is mailed.
A consumer should not assume that ignoring a collection notice makes the debt disappear.
